title: Website Forms and Zoho CRM Integration
seoTitle: Website Form to Zoho CRM: Capture Every Enquiry
seoDescription: Send website contact and quote forms straight into Zoho CRM with source tracking, assignment and instant acknowledgement. Options, UTM capture and spam control.
summary: A website form–Zoho CRM integration sends every contact, quote or demo request from your website straight into Zoho CRM as a lead, with the page it came from and its campaign source, so nothing waits in an inbox and marketing can see which pages bring enquiries.

dataPoints.label: Options
dataPoints.value: Zoho web-to-lead forms, form plugins with Zoho connectors, or a custom API integration

dataPoints.label: Capture
dataPoints.value: Name, company, contact details, requirement, landing page, UTM source, medium and campaign

dataPoints.label: Spam control
dataPoints.value: Server-side validation, rate limits and a CAPTCHA or honeypot

dataPoints.label: Follow-up
dataPoints.value: Instant email or WhatsApp acknowledgement and owner assignment

body:
## Why source tracking matters

Knowing that a lead came from a Google search for "custom CRM Noida" through a specific page tells you which content earns business. Store the landing page and UTM parameters with the lead.

## Keep forms short

Ask only what you need to respond well. See [landing pages that convert for B2B services](/blog/landing-pages-that-convert-for-b2b-services).

faqs.q: Will Zoho web-to-lead forms match my site design?
faqs.a: They can be styled, but a custom form posting to the Zoho API gives full control over design and validation.

faqs.q: Can the same lead go to Google Sheets as a backup?
faqs.a: Yes, a parallel write to a sheet or database is a sensible safety net.
